theme_and_archetype.description: An authoritative, data-dense 'Command Center' for staffing outreach. Minimalist structural grayscale with high-contrast signal colors to direct action. Emphasizes functional beauty, scanability, and F-Pattern information architecture.

typography.strategy: The 'Soft Utility' pairing. Outfit provides a geometric, slightly technical but approachable feel for headings and metrics. IBM Plex Sans ensures maximum legibility for data-heavy tables and dense recruitment information.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-semibold
scale.label: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-bold

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing inside containers (`p-6` or `p-8`) to prevent text collision. The 'Control Room' Grid for dashboards.

dashboard_grid.container: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
dashboard_grid.primary_chart: col-span-1 md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3 p-6 rounded-xl border

components_strategy.cards: Flat solid surfaces with 1px subtle borders in dark mode. No massive soft shadows in dark mode. Light mode uses 1px border + shadow-sm.
components_strategy.buttons: Must have explicit hover colors. Hover state color must be a lighter hue of the active state. Use `ring-2` for focus states.
components_strategy.navigation: Collapsible left sidebar for the Command Center. Use 'Crystal Glass' top header for mobile and sticky sections. Glassmorphism must use `backdrop-saturate-150`.
components_strategy.tables: Dense. Use `text-sm`. Status columns must use the status badge colors. Subgrid support for row alignment if necessary.
components_strategy.icons: Use `@phosphor-icons/react` for a technical, crisp, and high-end enterprise aesthetic. Install via `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.

animations.micro_interactions: Hover lift (`-translate-y-1`) for job cards and candidate profiles. Subtle `opacity-80` to `opacity-100` transition for secondary buttons.
animations.page_transitions: Framer motion staggered fade-in for grid items (`staggerChildren: 0.1`).
animations.technical: Avoid `transition-all`. Explicitly use `transition-colors duration-200` or `transition-transform duration-300 ease-out`.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on disabled or secondary backgrounds meets APCA standards. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for text-bearing overlays.

image_urls.description: Sleek black metallic texture with flowing curves, perfect for login or landing page backgrounds.
Abstract tunnel effect in blue tones. Use at very low opacity (10%) for empty states or dashboard hero sections.
Tech company logo for job postings or business profiles
Another tech company logo for the CRM pipeline

media.rules: Never use placeholder images (e.g., via.placeholder.com). If a user profile has no image, generate an initial-based SVG or use one of the avatars above.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST build this strictly as an Enterprise OS. Avoid 'toy-like' massive border-radii; stick to `rounded-lg` or `rounded-xl` maximum.
Implement Shadcn heavily for complex forms, tables, and dialogs. Strip away 'default' vercel looks by using the specified typography and tight borders.
Use standard grid F-pattern. The North Star metric (e.g., 'Total Candidates Matched' or 'Pipeline Value') must be top-left.
DO NOT use Inter or standard sans for headings. Apply `font-family: 'Outfit'`.
For Dark Mode, NEVER use pure `#000000`. Rely on `bg-zinc-950` and `bg-zinc-900`. Borders must be `border-zinc-800`.
All navigation/headers overlaying content must use the 'Crystal Glass' effect (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70` light, `bg-zinc-900/60` dark) with a `1px` subtle bottom border.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form fields, tabs).
